summary: One of the 30 founding proprietors of Hudson, NY, its recorder and mayor; John's 3rd cousin 8x removed.
bio: Path: Elizabeth → Joseph → John (b. 1703, Newport and Providence shipowner) → David. Brother Joseph Lawrence (b. 1729) wrote the first marine insurance policy in Rhode Island (3C8R).
